name: kairo-router
description: Applies Kairo project routes at Claude Code subagent launch, enforces Kairo role agents, dispatches approved plans and adds short CodeGraph context, failing open when Kairo is unavailable.

showContext.title: Inject pacing context
showContext.description: Include one concise quota pacing line in each prompt.

enforceAgents.title: Enforce Kairo role agents
enforceAgents.description: Deny subagent launches that are not a Kairo role agent, a Kairo wrapper, a gentle-ai actor or a plugin agent; generic agents inherit the orchestrator model and skip routing.

showCodeGraph.title: Inject CodeGraph context
showCodeGraph.description: Add a short list of relevant, current CodeGraph symbols to structural prompts; stale and vendored paths are dropped.
